label: SYNTHETIC DATA / PROPOSED INTEGRATION
note: Single source of truth for thresholds. No screen or other module may hard-code these values. 'approved' = approved for data-quality flagging in this synthetic prototype by BE1 (pending supervisor confirmation). 'draft' = disabled or demo-only until verified.

MISSING_FIELD.description: A required measurement field is empty.

UNIT_MISMATCH.description: Unit is not the expected unit, or the value looks like it is in another unit.

FUTURE_DATE.description: Measurement date is after the reporting date.

DUPLICATE.description: Same beneficiary has more than one original reading on the same date, or beneficiary is flagged as a possible duplicate.

IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE.description: Value is outside the physically plausible range for a child under 6 (data-quality check, not a growth judgement).

UNUSUAL_CHANGE.description: Change since the previous original reading is larger than a plausible monthly change.

GROWTH_TREND_DATA_CHECK.description: Data-quality check on the dated series: repeated flat weights or a series that moves against the expected direction. Not a growth interpretation.

GROWTH_INTERPRETATION.description: Growth classification against reference standards. Disabled until standards and thresholds are verified. No diagnosis.

AGE_TRANSITION.description: Reminders for children moving between age bands. Disabled/demo-only until age bands and service names are verified.

DISABILITY_40_PERCENT.description: Disability threshold rule. OFF. No eligibility decisions.
